1920.verdict: FAILS. Nothing is clipped, but nothing is composed either. A 938px-wide single-line Company input, a 1018px paper card, and 768px of empty cotton to the right of the H1. This is a 1440 layout stretched, not a 1920 layout.

v1WeaknessesToBeatIn_v2: No container ceiling. This is the primary defect and the reason the brief's 1920 target is unmet today.
The error style is `color: var(--color-noir)` with a `— ` pseudo-element prefix. An error is visually a slightly bolder caption. Nothing in the red family is spent on the one moment that needs it.

The 503 DELIVERY_NOT_CONFIGURED response — the state every real visitor hits today — renders as a generic bordered box appended below the consent checkbox, above the submit button, carrying the server's own sentence and an underlined mailto. It is the page's most likely outcome and its least designed one.
The form is a paper card floated in a cotton field: --color-paper on --color-cotton is a 1.06:1 separation. The card reads as a printing artifact, not a surface.
Six fields with identical hairline underlines, no rhythm, no sequence. Nothing tells the visitor how long this will take.
Two 4:5 stills (still-columns-15, still-team-55) placed as decoration. On mobile the ContactInfo still alone is 429px tall — a full thumb-scroll of nothing.
Submit hover is translateY(-2px) only; no colour move, and --color-accent-deep (maroon) — which exists precisely to be the hover depth step on a cherry field — is unused on the whole page.
The H1 'All progress starts with a conversation.' is generic and could sit on any studio's contact page. The site's own narrative (the elevator, floors, the ascent) is absent from /contact entirely.
